captions.detailed: A wall-mounted industrial articulating arm lamp featuring a dark gray rectangular backplate with four mounting bolt flanges. The arm assembly consists of two square-profile tubes connected by a central cylindrical elbow pivot, finished in matte black. At the outer end of the arm, a vertical rectangular block houses a silver-threaded drop rod that attaches to a deep cylindrical black lamp shade via a U-shaped swivel bracket. The joints allow for horizontal rotation at the wall bracket, folding at the elbow, vertical adjustment of the drop rod, and tilting of the lamp shade.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a wall-mounted articulating factory-style arm lamp. The assembly should feature a rectangular mounting bracket with bolt flanges, a two-segment folding square arm with cylindrical pivot joints, a vertically adjustable drop rod, and a deep cylindrical shade head with a tilt bracket.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first creating a backplate with four cylindrical bolt-hole flanges using box and cylinder primitives. The first and second arm segments are built from square-section boxes, joined by cylinder-based revolute pivot hardware. A vertical guide block is modeled as a box at the end of the outer arm, housing a threaded vertical drop rod made from stacked cylinders. Finally, a U-shaped tilt bracket is constructed using boolean subtractions on box primitives, which connects the drop rod to a deep cylindrical lamp shade.
